title: Novel Imaging Techniques for the Characterization of Musculoskeletal Tumors II
official: Novel Imaging Techniques for the Characterization of Musculoskeletal Tumors II: Texture Analysis and Artificial Intelligence
summary: This study aims at evaluating the value of various artificial intelligence based techniques to improve the characterization and image post-processing for patients with musculoskeletal tumors.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients suspected to have a bone or soft-tissue tumor referred for imaging for initial tumors characterization and staging.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Breast feeding patients
* Renal insufficiency
* Contra indications to MRI or CT
* Prior surgery or treatment to the evaluated lesion.
